## Strongest diagnosis

At the largest currently certified nonlinear radius, the largest eta accepted
by the coherent conditional estimate is below the eta required by the
incoherent degree-18 contour, even with ideal overlap one. Thus the current
two-channel proof has no common parameter. This is a quantified mechanism
deficit, not a Yang--Mills no-go theorem.
